fusions.name: Foraging Flight
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stingers in a spread, each dealing 2 damage. 30% of the damage they deal comes back to you as healing over the next 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Pollen Courier
fusions.desc: Bursts a pollen sac on one enemy for 12 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target are carried to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Honey Ration
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles. The amount rises with your cast speed.

fusions.name: Hive Tenant
fusions.desc: A swarm nesting in your hollow fights beside you, stinging an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every second and leaving it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health.
